Hi, I’m Chad.

Why I built this summit

I created the We! Connect Cards, co-wrote Ask Powerful Questions, and have led 1,000+ events sparking over 7 million conversations. The Connectors Summit was born from a desire to gather the smartest, most generous people I know: the humans designing the meetings, trainings, and events that spark connection.

It is a space to recharge, swap what works, sharpen our saws, and co-create a more connected future. Connection isn’t a warm-up here. Connection is the content. 9 out of 10 of last year’s attendees said they’d be back. Welcome home.

Frequently asked questions

When does registration close?
Friday, November 20 at 5 PM ET. The summit only happens once a year, so after Friday the doors close until 2027.
When is this happening?
Sessions run online December 9 to 11, 2026, with plenty of breaks. December 9 (2:00 to 5:00 pm ET) is the kickoff with connection before content and the opening keynote. December 10 (9:00 am to 4:00 pm ET) holds most workshops and connection labs; attend them all or pick the ones most relevant to you. December 11 (9:00 to 11:00 am ET) is a memorable collaborative closing and the reveal of what’s next. On December 2 there is an optional pre-conference with Mark Levy plus a tech check with Chad and the team. As soon as you register, you enter the community space for the summit.
Where is the summit happening?
It’s fully virtual, and exactly 0% of it happens on Zoom. We use a highly interactive platform built for small groups. Past attendees were delighted with the novel, creative, and human ways we use it, and you’ll get real value just from seeing how we run everything. You’ll also be invited into an online community space for connection before, during, and after the summit.
How big is the summit?
The world changes in small groups. Hundreds of practitioners attend, but you will never be in a group larger than 12. That’s why we don’t use Zoom, and it’s why the event sells out: we cap it to protect depth.
Who is this event for?
Professionals, leaders, facilitators, trainers, and L&D pros who are responsible for gathering people. The summit is designed for expert connectors to sharpen their skills and for aspiring group leaders to build a practical toolbox.
What if I have to miss a session?
Every session is recorded and posted the same day, with access for a year, plus all resources and cheat sheets. Block the dates if you can, but if life happens you’ll still have everything you need.
Can my organization pay?
Yes. Many attendees use professional development budgets. The checkout gives you a receipt you can submit.
What is the refund policy?
If you don’t love it, we’ll give you your money back with our 100% satisfaction guarantee.
